title: src/starting_slice/causal_matrix.ts has zero production callers — the slice contract never participates in certification
body:
Deferred from the 2026-08-28/29 audit fix pass. The finding was confirmed by an
adversarial verifier; it was not fixed in that pass for the reason below, which is
the fixing agent's own account after reading the code.

Wiring it in means editing bin/starting-slice.ts or bin/starting-slice.ts (bin/ is outside my ownership), and it is a product decision: making the shipped active_unproven matrix a hard gate changes what can certify. I fixed the narrow in-ownership half (the duplicated decision budget now has a drift pin); the rest needs the repo owner.
